dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Thin, pale marginal fringes visible on the distal edges of folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse demarcation separating the dark dorsal head region from the lighter grey-brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent transverse black and white barring on the visible tail feathers.
